98    /**
99     * Admin site configuration endpoint.
100     */
101    public function config(): void
102    {
103        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
104            session_set_cookie_params(43200);
105            session_start();
106        }
107
108        $hasPassword = !empty($this->site->metadata->indieauthPassword);
109
110        if (!$hasPassword) {
111            $this->handleBootstrap();
112            return;
113        }
114
115        if (isset($_GET['action']) && $_GET['action'] === 'logout') {
116            $_SESSION = [];
117            if (ini_get("session.use_cookies")) {
118                $params = session_get_cookie_params();
119                setcookie(
120                    session_name(),
121                    '',
122                    time() - 42000,
123                    $params["path"],
124                    $params["domain"],
125                    $params["secure"],
126                    $params["httponly"]
127                );
128            }
129            session_destroy();
130            $this->redirect('/admin/config');
131            return;
132        }
133
134        if (isset($_GET['code']) && isset($_GET['state'])) {
135            $this->handleCallback();
136            return;
137        }
138
139        if (empty($_SESSION['admin_authenticated'])) {
140            $this->redirectToAuth();
141            return;
142        }
143
144        if (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET') === 'POST') {
145            if (isset($_POST['action'])) {
146                if ($_POST['action'] === 'bsky_test') {
147                    header('Content-Type: application/json');
148                    $handle = trim((string) ($_POST['atproto_handle'] ?? Database::getSetting('atproto_handle') ?? ''));
149                    $password = trim((string) ($_POST['atproto_app_password'] ?? Database::getSetting('atproto_app_password') ?? ''));
150                    $pds = trim((string) ($_POST['atproto_pds_url'] ?? Database::getSetting('atproto_pds_url') ?? 'https://bsky.social'));
151                    $service = new \Indieinabox\AtProto\BskySyndicationService($this->site);
152                    $result = $service->testCredentials($handle, $password, $pds);
153                    echo json_encode($result);
154                    exit;
155                }
156                if ($_POST['action'] === 'generate_nostr_keys') {
157                    header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
158                    $pair = \Indieinabox\Nostr\NostrKey::generate();
159                    echo json_encode($pair);
160                    exit;
161                }
162                if ($_POST['action'] === 'manual_update' && !empty($_POST['download_url'])) {
163                    UpdateService::downloadAndInstall((string) $_POST['download_url']);
164                    $this->redirect('/admin/config?saved=1');
165                    return;
166                }
167                if ($_POST['action'] === 'rollback_update' && !empty($_POST['backup_filename'])) {
168                    UpdateService::rollback((string) $_POST['backup_filename']);
169                    $this->redirect('/admin/config?saved=1');
170                    return;
171                }
172                if ($_POST['action'] === 'rebuild_site') {
173                    $this->rebuildSite();
174                    $this->redirect('/admin/config?rebuilt=1');
175                    return;
176                }
177                if ($_POST['action'] === 'export_download') {
178                    $exportService = new ExportService($this->site);
179                    $exportDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'iiab_web_exports';
180                    if (!is_dir($exportDir)) {
181                        @mkdir($exportDir, 0755, true);
182                    }
183                    $exportFile = $exportDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'indieinabox_export_' . date('Y-m-d_His') . '.tar.gz';
184                    $skipContent = !empty($_POST['backup_skip_content']);
185                    $skipMedia = !empty($_POST['backup_skip_media']);
186
187                    $result = $exportService->export($exportFile, [
188                        'skip_content' => $skipContent,
189                        'skip_media' => $skipMedia,
190                    ]);
191
192                    if ($result['success'] && is_file($result['path'])) {
193                        header('Content-Description: File Transfer');
194                        header('Content-Type: application/gzip');
195                        header('Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="' . basename($result['path']) . '"');
196                        header('Expires: 0');
197                        header('Cache-Control: must-revalidate');
198                        header('Pragma: public');
199                        header('Content-Length: ' . (string) filesize($result['path']));
200                        readfile($result['path']);
201                        @unlink($result['path']);
202                        exit;
203                    }
204
205                    $this->redirect('/admin/config?export_error=1#tab-backups');
206                    return;
207                }
208                if ($_POST['action'] === 'import_upload') {
209                    if (isset($_FILES['import_file']) && is_array($_FILES['import_file']) && (int)($_FILES['import_file']['error'] ?? -1) === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
210                        $tmpPath = (string) $_FILES['import_file']['tmp_name'];
211                        if (is_uploaded_file($tmpPath) || is_file($tmpPath)) {
212                            $importService = new ImportService($this->site);
213                            try {
214                                $importService->import($tmpPath, [
215                                    'verify_checksums' => true,
216                                    'safety_backup' => true,
217                                    'rebuild_site' => true,
218                                ]);
219                                $this->redirect('/admin/config?imported=1#tab-backups');
220                                return;
221                            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
222                                $_SESSION['import_error_message'] = $e->getMessage();
223                                $this->redirect('/admin/config?import_error=1#tab-backups');
224                                return;
225                            }
226                        }
227                    }
228                    $this->redirect('/admin/config?import_error=1#tab-backups');
229                    return;
230                }
231            }
232            $this->saveConfig();
233            return;
234        }
235
236        $config = $this->settingsRepo ? $this->settingsRepo->all() : Database::getAllSettings();
237        $config['kinds'] = $this->settingsRepo ? $this->settingsRepo->getKinds() : Database::getKinds();
238        $config['translations'] = $this->settingsRepo ? $this->settingsRepo->getTranslations() : Database::getTranslations();
239        $this->html(ConfigView::renderConfig($this->site, $config));
240    }

282    /**
283     * Admin interactions and comments moderation panel.
284     */
285    public function moderation(): void
286    {
287        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
288            session_set_cookie_params(43200);
289            session_start();
290        }
291
292        if (empty($_SESSION['admin_authenticated'])) {
293            $fqdn = rtrim($this->site->metadata->fqdn ?? '', '/');
294            $this->redirect($fqdn . '/admin/config');
295            return;
296        }
297
298        if (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET') === 'POST') {
299            $action = (string) ($_POST['action'] ?? '');
300            $id = (string) ($_POST['id'] ?? '');
301            $type = (string) ($_POST['type'] ?? 'pending');
302
303            if ($action === 'approve') {
304                $this->moderationService->approveInteraction($id, $type);
305            } elseif ($action === 'delete') {
306                $this->moderationService->deleteInteraction($id, $type);
307            } elseif ($action === 'add_block') {
308                $domain = !empty($_POST['domain']) ? (string) $_POST['domain'] : null;
309                $actorUrl = !empty($_POST['actor_url']) ? (string) $_POST['actor_url'] : null;
310                $blockAction = !empty($_POST['block_action']) ? (string) $_POST['block_action'] : 'block';
311                $reason = !empty($_POST['reason']) ? (string) $_POST['reason'] : '';
312                $fedMod = new \Indieinabox\Moderation\ModerationService($this->db);
313                $fedMod->addBlock($domain, $actorUrl, $blockAction, $reason);
314            } elseif ($action === 'remove_block') {
315                $blockId = (int) ($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
316                $fedMod = new \Indieinabox\Moderation\ModerationService($this->db);
317                $fedMod->removeBlock($blockId);
318            }
319
320            $fqdn = rtrim($this->site->metadata->fqdn ?? '', '/');
321            $this->redirect($fqdn . '/admin/moderation');
322            return;
323        }
324
325        $repo = $this->moderationService->getRepository();
326        $pending = $repo->listByStatus('pending');
327        $spam = $repo->listByStatus('spam');
328
329        foreach ($pending as &$p) {
330            $p['id_filename'] = $p['id'];
331        }
332        foreach ($spam as &$s) {
333            $s['id_filename'] = $s['id'];
334        }
335
336        $fedMod = new \Indieinabox\Moderation\ModerationService($this->db);
337        $blocks = $fedMod->getBlocks();
338
339        $fqdn = rtrim($this->site->metadata->fqdn ?? '', '/');
340        $this->html(ModerationView::render($pending, $spam, $fqdn, $blocks));
341    }

358    /**
359     * Webhook endpoint triggering static site rebuild.
360     */
361    public function build(): void
362    {
363        if (!$this->validateWebhookToken('build_token', ['BUILD_TOKEN', 'WEBHOOK_TOKEN'])) {
364            return;
365        }
366
367        $isAsync = !empty($_GET['async']) || !empty($_POST['async']);
368        if ($isAsync) {
369            $db = $this->db ?? Database::getDb();
370            $stmt = $db->query("SELECT 1 FROM inbox_queue WHERE type = 'build_site'");
371            if (!$stmt->fetch()) {
372                $insert = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO inbox_queue (type, payload_json, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
373                $insert->execute(['build_site', json_encode([]), time()]);
374            }
375            $this->json([
376                'status' => 202,
377                'message' => 'Site build queued successfully.',
378            ], 202);
379            return;
380        }
381
382        $start = (float) microtime(true);
383        $this->rebuildSite();
384        $duration = round(((float) microtime(true) - $start) * 1000.0, 2);
385
386        $this->json([
387            'status' => 200,
388            'message' => 'Site rebuilt successfully.',
389            'duration_ms' => $duration,
390            'timestamp' => time(),
391        ], 200);
392    }

394    /**
395     * Validates incoming webhook token against configured tokens and environment variables.
396     *
397     * @param string $configKey Setting key name (e.g. 'cron_token' or 'build_token')
398     * @param list<string> $envFallbacks List of environment variable names to check
399     * @return bool True if authorized, false otherwise.
400     */
401    public function validateWebhookToken(string $configKey, array $envFallbacks = []): bool
402    {
403        $configuredToken = (string) ($this->site->config[$configKey] ?? '');
404        if ($configuredToken === '') {
405            $configuredToken = (string) ($this->settingsRepo
406                ? $this->settingsRepo->get($configKey, '')
407                : Database::getSetting($configKey, ''));
408        }
409        if ($configuredToken === '') {
410            foreach ($envFallbacks as $envName) {
411                $val = getenv($envName);
412                if ($val !== false && $val !== '') {
413                    $configuredToken = (string) $val;
414                    break;
415                }
416            }
417        }
418
419        $remoteAddr = (string) ($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '');
420        if ($remoteAddr !== '') {
421            $isLocal = in_array($remoteAddr, ['127.0.0.1', '::1', 'localhost'], true);
422        } else {
423            $isLocal = (PHP_SAPI === 'cli');
424        }
425
426        if ($configuredToken === '') {
427            if ($isLocal) {
428                return true;
429            }
430            $targetVar = $envFallbacks[0] ?? $configKey;
431            $this->json([
432                'status' => 403,
433                'error' => 'Forbidden: Token is not configured. Set ' . $targetVar . ' in environment or settings.',
434            ], 403);
435            return false;
436        }
437
438        $providedToken = (string) ($_GET['token'] ?? $_POST['token'] ?? '');
439        if ($providedToken === '') {
440            $auth = (string) ($_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'] ?? '');
441            if (str_starts_with($auth, 'Bearer ')) {
442                $providedToken = substr($auth, 7);
443            }
444        }
445        if ($providedToken === '') {
446            $providedToken = (string) (
447                $_SERVER['HTTP_X_WEBHOOK_TOKEN']
448                ?? $_SERVER['HTTP_X_CRON_TOKEN']
449                ?? $_SERVER['HTTP_X_BUILD_TOKEN']
450                ?? ''
451            );
452        }
453
454        if ($providedToken === '' || !hash_equals($configuredToken, $providedToken)) {
455            $this->json([
456                'status' => 401,
457                'error' => 'Unauthorized: Invalid or missing token.',
458            ], 401);
459            return false;
460        }
461
462        return true;
463    }

465    private function handleBootstrap(): void
466    {
467        if (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET') === 'POST') {
468            $password = (string) ($_POST['indieauth_password'] ?? '');
469            $sitename = (string) ($_POST['sitename'] ?? 'My Site Name');
470            $fqdn = (string) ($_POST['fqdn'] ?? '');
471
472            if ($password === '') {
473                $this->html(ConfigView::renderBootstrap('Password cannot be empty.'));
474                return;
475            }
476
477            $this->configService->bootstrap($password, $sitename, $fqdn);
478            $this->rebuildSite();
479            $this->redirect('/admin/microsub');
480            return;
481        }
482
483        $this->html(ConfigView::renderBootstrap());
484    }

486    private function redirectToAuth(): void
487    {
488        $state = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
489        $_SESSION['auth_state'] = $state;
490
491        $fqdn = rtrim($this->site->metadata->fqdn ?? '', '/');
492        $clientId = $fqdn . '/admin/config';
493        $redirectUri = $fqdn . '/admin/config';
494
495        $authUrl = $fqdn . '/auth'
496            . '?client_id=' . urlencode($clientId)
497            . '&redirect_uri=' . urlencode($redirectUri)
498            . '&state=' . urlencode($state)
499            . '&scope=config'
500            . '&response_type=code';
501
502        $this->redirect($authUrl);
503    }
504
505    private function handleCallback(): void
506    {
507        $state = (string) ($_GET['state'] ?? '');
508        $code = (string) ($_GET['code'] ?? '');
509
510        if (empty($_SESSION['auth_state']) || !hash_equals($_SESSION['auth_state'], $state)) {
511            http_response_code(400);
512            echo 'Invalid state parameter.';
513            return;
514        }
515
516        $db = $this->db ?? Database::getDb();
517        $codeHash = hash('sha256', $code);
518        $stmt = $db->prepare('SELECT * FROM indieauth_codes WHERE code_hash = :hash');
519        $stmt->bindValue(':hash', $codeHash);
520        $stmt->execute();
521        $codeData = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
522
523        if (!$codeData) {
524            http_response_code(400);
525            echo 'Invalid or expired authorization code.';
526            return;
527        }
528
529        $stmtDel = $db->prepare('DELETE FROM indieauth_codes WHERE code_hash = :hash');
530        $stmtDel->bindValue(':hash', $codeHash);
531        $stmtDel->execute();
532
533        if ($codeData['expires_at'] < time()) {
534            http_response_code(400);
535            echo 'Authorization code has expired.';
536            return;
537        }
538
539        $expectedClientId = rtrim($this->site->metadata->fqdn ?? '', '/') . '/admin/config';
540        if (rtrim($codeData['client_id'], '/') !== rtrim($expectedClientId, '/')) {
541            http_response_code(400);
542            echo 'Client ID mismatch.';
543            return;
544        }
545
546        $_SESSION['admin_authenticated'] = true;
547        unset($_SESSION['auth_state']);
548
549        $redirectUrl = $_SESSION['redirect_after_login'] ?? '/admin/microsub';
550        unset($_SESSION['redirect_after_login']);
551
552        $this->redirect($redirectUrl);
553    }
